claim: Subtiel is a one-star Michelin restaurant at Westhoeklaan 31, De Panne 8660, on the Belgian coast near the French border.
quote: Subtiel – De Panne — Westhoeklaan 31, 8660 De Panne

claim: The Belgian Coast Tram runs 67 km from De Panne (French border) to Knokke-Heist (Dutch border), placing Oostende roughly midway along the coast.
quote: At 67 kilometres (42 mi) in length, it is currently the world's longest tram line. It runs along the entire Belgian coast from De Panne, near the French border, to Knokke-Heist, near the Dutch border.

claim: Driving distance De Panne to Ieper (Ypres) is roughly 37 km, about 37 minutes by car — at the outer edge of a 30 km radius.
quote: De Panne to Ypres — 37 km, ~37 min

claim: Dunkerque Digital Day 2026 was held 7 May 2026 at Digital Lab ArcelorMittal, Dunkerque; topics: AI, 5G, IoT, industrial networks, cybersecurity.
quote: Dunkerque Digital Day — 7 May 2026, 8:30 AM – 3:00 PM, Digital Lab ARCELOR, Dunkerque. Topics: Artificial Intelligence, 5G, IoT, Industrial networks, Cybersecurity.

claim: DK Hub Global 2026 — three-in-one industrial trade show (Industrissime, Genead, Pharma+Agro) — was held 20-21 May 2026 in Dunkerque.
quote: DK Hub Global — Dunkerque France Nord Benelux — 2026

claim: DK Hub Global combines Industrissime (multi-sector industrial), Genead (energy engineering) and Pharma+Agro (pharma, food, cosmetics) under one roof.
quote: INDUSTRISSIME — multi-sector industrial salon; GENEAD — energy engineering; PHARMA+AGRO — pharmaceutical, food processing, and cosmetics sectors.

claim: La French Tech Littoral Hauts-de-France has been labelled since 2019 and operates as the innovation network for Dunkerque, Calais, Boulogne and Montreuil.
quote: French Tech Littoral Hauts-de-France — labellisée depuis 2019, moteur d'innovation entre Dunkerque, Calais, Boulogne et Montreuil.

claim: Blue Innovation Village at Ostend at Anchor 2026 runs Thursday 28 May – Sunday 31 May 2026 at the trade docks, Oostende; free, open 10am–6pm daily.
quote: Blue Innovation Village at Ostend at Anchor 2026 — 28-31 May 2026, Ostend; located at the end of the trade docks (across the town hall); open every day from 10 am to 6 pm; free event.

claim: Ostend at Anchor 2026 is a four-day maritime festival featuring 100+ classic sailing ships, attracting 200,000+ visitors last edition.
quote: Ostend at Anchor — more than 100 classic sailing ships, more than 200,000 visitors last year.

claim: Blue Cluster's 2026 Oostende calendar includes 'Nature Restoration in the Belgian Part of the North Sea' (28 May) and 'Navigating the North Sea' with Minister Annelies Verlinden (2 June).
quote: May 28, 2026 | Ostend — Nature Restoration in the Belgian Part of the North Sea (12-5pm); June 2, 2026 | Ostend — Navigating the North Sea (1-7pm); Marine Spatial Plan dialogue with Minister Annelies Verlinden.

claim: Belgian Offshore Days 2026 was held 11-12 March 2026 at Ostend Sea P'lace; two-day BOC conference + exhibition + Blue Talent Day; free with registration.
quote: The next edition of the Belgian Offshore Days takes place on 11 and 12 March 2026 at Ostend Sea P'lace, Kon. Astridlaan 10, 8400 Oostende.

claim: The Beacon (Antwerp-based digital innovation hub) runs Smart Port Week visits to Oostende's Maritime/Hydraulics Laboratory and Skills Lab.
quote: Smart Port Week — visits to the Maritime/Hydraulics Laboratory in Ostend and its Towing Tank with R&D explanations on autonomous shipping, Skills Lab training centre, demonstrations of remotely piloted inland vessels and autonomous shipping.

claim: Bluebridge at Ostend Science Park is a blue-economy incubator with 200-capacity event space, hosting startups in aquaculture, blue energy, marine biotech, coastal protection and blue tourism.
quote: Bluebridge brings together various stakeholders within this cluster to promote innovation and sustainable development in the marine and maritime sectors, such as aquaculture, blue energy, marine biotechnology, coastal protection, deep-sea mining and blue tourism. Meeting facilities for up to 150 people; capacity up to 200 for events.

claim: Greenbridge (now Ostend Science Park) is a business incubator at Ghent University's Ostend campus, focused on tech transfer in marine/maritime domains.
quote: The Ostend Science Park is a business incubator located at the Ghent University campus in Ostend.

claim: Spark Lab is Dunkerque's first FabLab, opened January 2018; offers workshops, digital fabrication and a community-event space for makers and digital projects.
quote: Spark Lab — The first FabLab in Dunkerque, inaugurated in January 2018. It encourages imagination, experimentation and project development by proposing workshops, events and a digital space.

claim: Voka West-Vlaanderen's 2026 Westhoek programme prioritises space-for-business in Veurne, Ieper, Poperinge and Diksmuide, but no tech-conference programme is announced.
quote: In 2026, clarity is expected on future perspectives for companies wanting to grow in Ieper, Veurne, Poperinge and Diksmuide.

claim: Torque 2026 — leading European wind-energy science conference — runs 3-5 June 2026 in Bruges (~50 km from Subtiel, outside the 30 km radius).
quote: Torque 2026: The Science of Making Torque from Wind — 3-5 June 2026, Bruges.

claim: Devoxx Belgium, the country's flagship developer conference, runs 5-9 October 2026 in Antwerp — well outside the De Panne 30 km radius (~145 km).
quote: Devoxx Belgium — 5-9 October 2026, Antwerp.

claim: Belgian Offshore Days is organised by the Belgian Offshore Cluster with POM West-Vlaanderen and Blue Cluster, as the annual forum of Belgium's offshore-wind sector.
quote: Belgian Offshore Days — initiative of the Belgian Offshore Cluster, organised with the support of POM West-Vlaanderen and Blue Cluster.

claim: DK Hub Global 2026 was hosted at Le Kursaal Dunkerque on 20-21 May 2026, positioning Dunkerque as an industry innovation hub.
quote: DK Hub Global — Le Kursaal, Dunkerque — 20 et 21 mai 2026.
